name: Heterogeneous-Race-Free (HRF)
description: The foundational framework that introduced scoped synchronisation. It generalises data-race-free (DRF) to a scope hierarchy, distinguishing HRF-direct (scopes must match exactly) and HRF-indirect (transitive scope chains). Heterogeneous-race-free programs get an SC-like guarantee; using sub-global scopes admits behaviours flat DRF forbids. Most subsequent GPU models build on it.

catSupport.note: HRF-direct and HRF-indirect are conditions on a single execution (scoped races, scoped happens-before), which herd's bell/cat scope support expresses; the paper gives them in prose and set notation.
